diagnosis.summary: Payment-service is returning errors on 100% of requests with p95 latency at 4303.56 ms, up from a baseline of 4.5 ms. Order-service, which calls payment-service on every POST /orders, shows 47.62% 5xx errors and 110 dependency errors per minute. Both services have been in this state for 3 minutes.
diagnosis.root_cause: A complete failure of payment-service, with 100% 5xx error rate and p95 latency rising roughly 955x above baseline, is the most likely root cause of this dependency failure.
evidence: Payment-service error_rate_5xx is 1.0 (100%) in the current window, up from a baseline of 0.
Payment-service p95 latency rose from 4.51 ms to 4303.56 ms, an increase of roughly 955x.
Order-service dependency_error_count is 110 per minute, up from a baseline of 0.

Order-service dependency_latency_ms_p95 rose from 22.1 ms to 4318.97 ms and closely matches payment-service p95_latency_ms at 4303.56 ms, indicating the latency is accumulated within payment-service's own handling.
Order-service error_rate_5xx is 0.4762 (47.62%), up from a baseline of 0, and order-service p95 latency rose from 25.1 ms to 4321.22 ms, roughly 172x.
Payment-service lambda_duration_ms_mean is 1.669 ms, only marginally above its baseline of 0.5855 ms, despite p95 end-to-end latency exceeding 4300 ms.
recommended_actions: Inspect payment-service CloudWatch Logs at /aws/lambda/anomalypulse-payment to identify what error or exception is producing the 100% 5xx rate.
Check payment-service lambda_throttle_count in CloudWatch; throttled invocations fail immediately and add to order-service dependency_error_count without increasing lambda handler duration.
Verify whether GET requests to order-service are healthy, since only POST /orders invokes payment-service and unaffected paths would confirm the failure is isolated to that dependency.
Once the payment-service fault is identified and fixed, do not add retries to order-service's call while payment-service is still struggling, as each retry adds another invocation and more latency.
After each remediation step, recheck payment-service error_rate_5xx and order-service dependency_error_count to confirm recovery.
